transport: inherited fd1 unnamed AF_UNIX SOCK_STREAM; nonblocking; no arbitrary fd/path

framing.invalid: sticky terminal; extra/reordered/duplicate frame, EOF, overflow, backpressure or deadline fails completeness

uuid.grammar: lowercase nonzero canonical UUID; hyphens at8,13,18,23

HELLO.candidate_mac: u8[6]; equals admitted child argv MAC

strictness: Every key required; reject unknown/duplicates at every nesting depth
Integers reject negative, fractional, exponent, overflow; arrays exact length; booleans exact
Canonical ASCII strings; no escaped/control/noncanonical identity spelling
JSON order-independent on input; compact deterministic struct ordering on output
No payload/header/key/path/arbitrary error string in receipts
ARM generation must equal candidate generation and selector; both bindings distinct; echo exact operation/pair/interval
Child candidate lease getter verifies address, MAC, gateway, now<expiry without policy mutation; no peer Policy lease exists
Because admitted strings need no escapes, a narrow raw ASCII/no-backslash precheck may enforce spelling before serde; it must not become a bespoke JSON parser.
accounting: All counters saturate/refuse at4096, set overflow permanently; no reset at window close
Identified vm row count equals sum corresponding six terminal outcomes
Host row count equals sum corresponding six outcomes
Started equals completed for complete receipt; no pending tickets
Write attempts equal full+length_mismatch+error outcomes; each actual attempted dispatch attempts once
Full/length_mismatch determined from actual raw returned length vs requested, not replay; any length mismatch sets incomplete
Host expected/candidate row is exact peer-MAC reply subset; unexpected sender includes Ethernet/ARP sender mismatch, never confirmed proxy provenance
Byte totals aggregate ephemeral per-dispatch observed lengths, not individual packet histories
Recognized unsupported/truncated pair headers prevent completeness; unidentifiable malformed frames cannot support global absence
complete requires loss=false, overflow=false, invalid_flags all false, candidate lease still valid, exact clock/deadline/pair and arithmetic
Raw API status category captured before original error conversion; packet count unobserved always true
Refresh failure sets loss=true regardless of completed terminal ticket. Any successful returned length unequal to requested is api_length_mismatch and incomplete; preserve canonical Ok.
For each direction sum refresh_results equals dispatch_started, including not_attempted outer/filter exits; any attempted failure sets loss.
For each vm row sum vm_lease_state equals vm_identified; each of the two target predicate bucket sums independently equals vm_identified, including not_evaluated.
expired_cleared captures actual current dispatch expiry transition, never an expired lease still present after Policy.refresh; earlier-cleared lease is missing.
The gateway/local predicate counts are actual evaluation operands; no relation requires both to have been evaluated.
host_pair_arp_request cannot contribute to host_reply_class or host_class_outcomes; unsupported/truncated counters invalidate completeness, never masquerade as supported replies.
unresolved_required_gates: Root approval/freezing of exact array catalogue and strict lexical canonical JSON behavior
hostx.Manifest parser/validation parity; self-image descriptor path identity and Darwin ACL/group checks
Actual child fd1 flags and full-duplex inheritance through Tart/Foundation; no live execution authorized
Shared dispatch imports used by Proxy and independent canonical oracle fixture; no upstream privileged runner

actual_decision_metadata.refresh_results: rows vm/host; count actual refresh closure return, or existing path that never attempts it; no second refresh
actual_decision_metadata.vm_lease_state: rows arp_request/arp_reply/tcp22_syn. Refresh failure =>not_evaluated. On actual successful Policy.refresh, reuse its existing expiry branch: expired_cleared means that branch cleared the lease and the choosing state is now None; missing means already None. Otherwise compare that same live lease address to immutable candidate bound address. This observation never selects policy or refreshes again. MAC/gateway are already launch-bound; packet sender comparison remains actual arp_reason.
actual_decision_metadata.vm_target_predicates: rows vm_rows, columns gateway_equal/current_host_local_contains, buckets not_evaluated/false/true. Capture only predicates executed in the actual choosing ARP/IPv4 branch. Preserve short circuit: malformed/source rejection skips target predicates; gateway true skips local contains; no lease skips local contains. A skipped predicate is never false.
actual_decision_metadata.lease_getter: ARM/end read-only current lease admission remains separate; per-decision metadata must not come from ARM/end getters or later re-evaluation.

host_reply_row_admission.required: validated Ethernet/IPv4 ARP hardware/protocol lengths and fixed sender/target IPv4 tuple control->candidate AND opcode exactly2; classify BEFORE allowlist/refresh/MAC filter
host_reply_row_admission.sender_expected: Ethernet src and ARP sender hardware both equal bound control MAC; mismatch =>unexpected
host_reply_row_admission.destination: Ethernet dest candidate MAC/broadcast/other; ARP target protocol address already equals candidate IPv4
host_reply_row_admission.opcode1: identified well-formed pair ARP request increments host_pair_arp_request only; excluded from six reply rows/outcomes; no claim it is a reply
host_reply_row_admission.other_opcode: identified fixed-layout pair opcode other than1/2 increments recognized_unsupported_pair[host], sets incomplete; excluded from reply rows
host_reply_row_admission.unsupported_or_truncated: existing recognized_unsupported_pair/recognized_truncated_pair count identifiable classes; unidentifiable malformed tuple remains explicit incomplete coverage, never zero-reply evidence
host_reply_row_admission.coverage: six rows cover supported validated same-IP replies only; do not imply all ARP or global absence
